programmes.t: Nurses Who Kill: Vickie Dawn Jackson
programmes.d: Vickie Dawn Jackson was described as sweet and 'gone to fat' by locals in her small Texas town. Why did Vickie kill off the friends and relatives of those whom she knew in Nocona, Texas?
